Creating energy for Iowa and America
Lincolnway Energy, LLC was formed in May 2004 when investors came together to build a 50 million gallon per year dry mill ethanol plant. To keep up with the growing industry and generate additional revenue for the company, we've expanded to provide other co-products including dried distillers grains, carbon dioxide, and corn oil.
Our Mission
Lincolnway Energy strives to be an efficient and low-cost producer of ethanol. Growing demand will keep the ethanol industry expanding and will help assure a strong future for clean, renewable, and domestically produced fuels that will benefit the country. Lincolnway Energy wants to be a long-term player to continue to make this happen.
